description: This file defines the ReturnStatus model class for the Opencart admin localisation module. It contains methods for managing return statuses, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return status data, descriptions, and counts.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing return statuses within the localisations module of Opencart admin.

methods.name: addReturnStatus
methods.description: Adds a new return status, inserts data into the database, and updates descriptions and cache.

methods.name: editReturnStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing return status by deleting and re-adding descriptions and clearing cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatus
methods.description: Deletes a return status record from the database and clears cache.

methods.name: getReturnStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return status for a given ID and current language.

methods.name: getReturnStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of all return statuses for the current language, with optional sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getTotalReturnStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of return statuses for the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific return status and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a return status.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all return status descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteReturnStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.
